title: 第四章 小孩子才做选择
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
而且，沐游本以为在这个遍地魔法的世界，魔法咒语这种东西应该很便宜才对，没想到，咒语反而是最贵的商品！
一个最普通的低级火焰咒，都要100年寿命！那些更高级的魔法就更不用想了，绝不是现在的他能够染指的。
沐游可惜的摇了摇头，准备离开商店。
谁知这时，游戏中又弹出了新的文本。
【老猫店主似乎看出了你的拮据，作为新顾客福利，它免费增送了你一卷治疗绷带，希望你以后能够多多照顾它的生意。】
【治疗绷带：处理伤口的紧急用品，使用后可以瞬间治愈伤势，或者在受到物理攻击时，避免一次死亡。】
“哦吼？”
沐游眼睛一亮，顿时感动的稀里哗啦。
这是什么绝世好老板？
虽然这绷带不能直接加寿命，但却可以避免一次死亡，正是他现在最需要的东西。
更重要的是：免费免费免费！！
在这个充满恶意的世界，只有猫老板的店里，还能感受到一丝温暖。
【临走之前，猫店主告诉你，猫头鹰商店里每天凌晨都会上架三件随机商品，记得每天都来看看，说不定就会有你需要的。】
“没问题老板，等我以后发达了，肯定天天照顾你生意！”
沐游默默在心里说了句，选择了【离开】。
【你离开了猫头鹰商店，重新上路。】
【你看到在雪路的尽头，有点点灯火缭绕，很熟悉的景象。就快到了！前方不远处，就是一座村庄！】
【你加紧赶路，终于来到了村庄前方。】
沐游心说不容易啊，被各种小动物欺负了一路，可算特么的找到安全区了……话说，进了村庄总不会还有危险吧？
【你正要进入村子，忽然发现前方村口处，有一个倒在血泊中的长胡子猎人，是否上前查看？】

哦？这是触发了什么事件？
多年的游戏经验告诉他，这种剧情多半是有好处可拿，沐游急忙选择了‘是’。
【你上前查看，这个背着猎枪的猎人，似乎是在森林里打猎时受了伤，浑身布满了某种野兽撕咬的伤口，流血不止，他虚弱的看着你，向你求救。你选择……】
【抢劫他：猎人身上有很多宝物，趁他虚弱，正是抢劫他的好时机。】
【治疗他：用你的绷带替他治疗伤势，或许他会感激你，从而给你一些好处。】
【视而不见：你装作没看见的走进村子，任他默默等死。】
“抢劫他！”
三个选项，沐游果断选了第一个。
【你眼中闪动着贪婪的光芒，选择趁人之危抢劫猎人。】
【猎人大怒，濒死的他竟然回光返照，跳起来一斧子砍死了你！】
“我去，猎人大哥我错了！”
沐游发现他果然还是太高估自己的战斗力了，哪怕是濒死的猎人，也不是他能妄想的。
回溯回溯。
【时光流转，你重新站在了猎人身前，这次，你选择……】
“治疗他。”
沐游选择了第二项。
虽然治疗猎人会消耗掉自己的绷带，但眼下这情况，应该能触发某种剧情，先看看值不值再说。
【你选择用绷带治疗猎人。】
【绷带散发出微弱的白光，治愈了猎人的大部分伤口。猎人活了下来，他十分感激你的帮助，决定给你一些好处作为报答。是否接受？】
来了来了！

沐游等的就是这一刻，果断接受！
【猎人是村子里有名的捕猎高手和驯兽大师，同时精通远射技巧。你可以在以下三种咒语中，选择一项作为救治他的回报。】
【百发百中：射击咒语，释放后的短时间内，你对各种远程武器的射击精度大大提高。】
【捕兽陷阱：陷阱咒语，消耗木材或金属，在地上创造出一个隐蔽的捕兽陷阱，生物经过时，将其困入其中。】
【动物对话：驯兽咒语，释放后使动物拥有灵性，能够听懂你的命令，对越高级的动物成功率越低。】
“咒语！！”
沐游惊喜啊！
三个选项，全都是咒语！
而且，看说明，每一个效果都十分强大！
很快沐游就陷入了一种幸福的烦恼中，因为，三个咒语他只能选一个……
唔，等等……
沐游忽然想起了什么。
他为什么要选？
别人或许需要选择，但他有时光怀表啊，全都要不可以么？
咒语这东西和别的实物奖励可不一样，咒语属于一种记忆。
如果是实物奖励，在逆转时间之后，实物会跟着消失。
但记忆，那是直接刻在他脑子里的，就算时间回溯了，他总不可能再忘掉吧？
当然，沐游也无法确定这游戏会不会让他钻这么明显的空子，先试试再说。
沐游选择了第三个‘动物对话’。
作为一家宠物店的老板，没有比这个更实用的魔法了！

【你已学会‘动物对话’！】
在文本弹出的瞬间，沐游只感觉脑海里多了一段繁杂绕口的口诀，明明是他不认识的语言，他却可以像母语一样熟练的读出来。
来不及品味这段玄奥咒语的内涵，五秒的时间稍纵即逝，沐游急忙按下怀表。
时光倒退，重回选项之前。
面前还是那三个选项。
同时，沐游脑海里的咒文记忆，并没有消失！
沐游大喜，居然真的可以卡bug！
【请在以下三项咒语中，选择一项……】
“不好意思，我全都要！”
沐游果断如法炮制，很快又将其他两个咒语学了过来。
感受着脑海中漂浮的三条咒语，沐游心满意足，原来这才是回溯时间最IMBA的用法！
继续继续！
一下白嫖了三条珍贵的咒语，之前牺牲的两条命似乎都不那么心疼了。
而且游戏中他也已经到达了村庄，接下来肯定有更多新奇的事件等着他发掘！
沐游现在正是游戏热情最高涨之时，迫不及待的点击继续游戏，结果……
【愚者，你今日的行动力已用完，疲劳状态下强行行动，有可能导致形体消散，你最好立即停下休息整顿，待明日行动力恢复之后，再继续上路。】
content_en:
Moreover, Mu You thought that in this world full of magic, magic spells should be cheap, but unexpectedly, spells were the most expensive commodity!
The most common low-level fire spell has a lifespan of 100 years! There is no need to think about those more advanced magics, which are definitely not within his reach now.
Mu You shook his head sadly and prepared to leave the store.
Unexpectedly, at this time, a new text popped up in the game.
[The old cat shop owner seems to have noticed your financial difficulties. As a bonus for new customers, he will give you a free roll of therapeutic bandages. He hopes that you can take care of his business in the future. 】
[Therapeutic bandage: an emergency supply for treating wounds. After use, it can instantly heal the injury, or avoid death when being attacked by a physical attack. 】
"Oh ho?"
Mu You's eyes lit up and he was suddenly moved.
What kind of great boss is this?
Although this bandage cannot directly increase lifespan, it can prevent one death, which is what he needs most now.
What’s more: free, free, free! !
In this world full of malice, only Boss Cat's shop can still feel a touch of warmth.
[Before you leave, the cat shop owner tells you that three random items will be put on sale in the Owl Store every early morning. Remember to come and take a look every day, maybe you will find what you need. 】
"No problem, boss. When I become prosperous in the future, I will definitely take care of your business every day!"
Mu You said silently in his heart and chose to "leave".
[You left the Owl Store and hit the road again. 】
[You see some lights twinkling at the end of the snowy road, a very familiar sight. Almost there! Not far ahead is a village! 】
[You hurry up and finally arrive in front of the village. 】
Mu Youxin said it was not easy. After being bullied by various small animals all the way, she finally found a safe zone... By the way, there is no danger after entering the village, right?
[You are about to enter the village, and suddenly you find a bearded hunter lying in a pool of blood at the entrance of the village in front of you. Do you want to step forward to check? 】
oh? What event did this trigger?
Years of gaming experience told him that this kind of plot would probably have benefits, so Mu You hurriedly chose 'yes'.
[You step forward to check. This hunter carrying a shotgun seems to have been injured while hunting in the forest. His whole body is covered with wounds from some kind of wild beast, and he is bleeding. He looks at you weakly and asks you for help. You choose...]
[Rob him: The hunter has a lot of treasures on him. It is a good time to rob him while he is weak. 】
[Treat him: Use your bandage to treat his injuries. Maybe he will be grateful to you and give you some benefits. 】
[Turn a blind eye: You walked into the village pretending not to see him and left him waiting to die silently. 】
"Rob him!"
Of the three options, Mu You decisively chose the first one.
[With greed shining in your eyes, you choose to rob the hunter while others are in danger. 】
[The hunter was so angry that when he was about to die, he suddenly came back to his senses, jumped up and chopped you to death with an axe! 】
"I'll go, Brother Hunter, I was wrong!"
Mu You found that he had indeed overestimated his own fighting power. Even if he was a dying hunter, it was not something he could imagine.
Backtracking backtracking.
[Time passes and you stand in front of the hunter again. This time, you choose...]
"Treat him."
Mu You chose the second option.
Although healing the hunter will consume his own bandages, the current situation should trigger some kind of plot. Let's see if it's worth it first.
[You choose to use a bandage to treat the hunter. 】
[The bandage emits a faint white light and heals most of the hunter's wounds. The hunter survived. He was very grateful for your help and decided to give you some benefits in return. Do you want to accept it? 】
Coming, coming!
Mu You had been waiting for this moment and accepted it decisively!
[The hunter is a well-known hunting master and beast taming master in the village. He is also proficient in long-distance shooting.Shooting skills. You can choose one of the following three spells in return for healing him. 】
[Always hit: Shooting spell, within a short period of time after being released, your shooting accuracy against various long-range weapons will be greatly improved. 】
[Beast Trap: Trap spell, consumes wood or metal, creates a hidden beast trap on the ground, and traps creatures in it when they pass by. 】
[Animal dialogue: The animal taming spell, after being released, makes the animal spiritual and able to understand your commands. The success rate is lower for more advanced animals. 】
"Spell!!"
Muyou is pleasantly surprised!
Three options, all spells!
Moreover, looking at the description, every effect is very powerful!
Soon Mu You fell into a kind of happy trouble, because he could only choose one of the three spells...
Um, wait...
Mu You suddenly remembered something.
Why should he choose?
Others may need to choose, but if he has a time pocket watch, can he want them all?
Spells are different from other physical rewards. Spells are a kind of memory.
If it is a physical reward, the physical object will disappear after the time is reversed.
But the memory was engraved directly in his mind. Even if time went back, he couldn't forget it, right?
Of course, Mu You was not sure whether this game would allow him to take advantage of such an obvious loophole, so he would give it a try first.
Mu You chose the third ‘Animal Dialogue’.
As a pet store owner, there is no magic more practical than this!
【You have learned ‘Animal Talk’! 】
The moment the text popped up, Mu You felt that there was a complicated and convoluted formula in his mind. It was obviously a language he didn't know, but he could read it as proficiently as his native language.
There was no time to appreciate the connotation of this mysterious spell. Five seconds passed by quickly, and Mu You hurriedly pressed his pocket watch.
Go back in time and go back to before options.
There are still those three options before me.
At the same time, the memory of the mantra in Mu You's mind has not disappeared!
Mu You was overjoyed that the bug was actually stuck!
[Please choose one of the following three spells...]
"Sorry, I want them all!"
Mu You decisively followed the same example and quickly learned the other two spells.
Feeling the three spells floating in his mind, Mu You was satisfied. It turned out that this was the most IMBA way to go back in time!
Keep going!
Three precious spells were used in vain, and the two lives sacrificed before seemed to be less painful.
Moreover, he has already reached the village in the game, and there will definitely be more novel events waiting for him to discover!
Muyou is now at the peak of his enthusiasm for the game. He can't wait to click to continue the game. The result...
[Fool, you have used up all your mobility today. If you forcefully move while you are tired, your body may dissipate. You'd better stop and rest immediately. After your mobility is restored tomorrow, you can continue on the road. 】
